description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable Policy class, including methods for creating, modifying, serializing, and deserializing policy objects, with a focus on JSON conversion and policy entry management.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicy
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Policy interface, providing methods for policy management, JSON serialization/deserialization, and policy entry modifications.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Policy instance with specified ID, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and entries.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutablePolicy object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the optional PolicyId of the policy.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the optional namespace string.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the optional PolicyLifecycle.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the optional PolicyRevision.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns the optional last modified timestamp.

methods.name: getCreated
methods.description: Returns the optional creation timestamp.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Returns a new Policy with the specified PolicyEntry set.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns the set of labels for the policy entries.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a label exists in the policy entries.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyEntry for a given label.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes the PolicyEntry for a given label.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Sets subjects for a specific policy entry label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a subject for a specific policy entry label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject from a policy entry.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets resources for a specific policy entry label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a resource for a specific policy entry label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource from a policy entry.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Retrieves effected permissions for a specific label, subject ID, and resource key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the policy has no entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the policy.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a set of all PolicyEntry objects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of PolicyEntry objects.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the PolicyEntry objects.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy to a JSON object with schema version and predicate filtering.
